query: SELECT n.slug AS node_slug, n.id AS node_id, n.label, a.id AS article_id, a.url AS article_url, e.id AS event_id, e.canonical_title FROM public.nodes n LEFT JOIN public.articles a ON a.url = CASE n.slug WHEN 'evt-doj-louisville-minneapolis-dismissal-20250521' THEN 'https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/us-department-justices-civil-rights-division-dismisses-biden-era-police-investigations-and' WHEN 'evt-doj-seattle-support-20250723' THEN 'https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/justice-department-supports-seattles-motion-terminate-police-department-consent-decree' WHEN 'evt-doj-norfolk-termination-20250813' THEN 'https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/federal-court-grants-justice-departments-motion-terminate-47-year-old-consent-decree' END LEFT JOIN public.events e ON e.canonical_title = CASE n.slug WHEN 'evt-doj-louisville-minneapolis-dismissal-20250521' THEN 'DOJ announced dismissal steps for Louisville and Minneapolis actions' WHEN 'evt-doj-seattle-support-20250723' THEN 'DOJ announced support for Seattle termination motion' WHEN 'evt-doj-norfolk-termination-20250813' THEN 'Court granted DOJ motion regarding Norfolk decree' END WHERE n.slug IN ('evt-doj-louisville-minneapolis-dismissal-20250521', 'evt-doj-seattle-support-20250723', 'evt-doj-norfolk-termination-20250813') ORDER BY n.slug LIMIT 10;
